label: AppLovin Ads (AXON)
terms_note: Report Key from the dashboard account menu; GET https://r.applovin.com/report with api_key, start / end, columns, format; rate limits not stated. Free.

discovery.auth: api_key (Report Key from the AppLovin dashboard, api_key query parameter)

auth: 1. AppLovin advertiser account → dashboard account menu → Report Key.

endpoints.notes: api_key, start, end, columns (day, campaign, ad, ad_creative_type, country, ad_rev_«x», ad_roas_«x»…), format, report_type advertiser

reference.limits: - Rate limits not stated; free; AppLovin advertiser terms.

fields.name: campaign_api_key
fields.help: Campaign Management API key (AppLovin dashboard > your account, top right > Keys; not the Ad Unit Management key), sent as the raw `Authorization` header value on api.ads.axon.ai.

fields.name: report_key
fields.help: Report Key (dashboard > account > Keys), sent as the api_key query parameter of GET https://r.applovin.com/report; needed only for get_report.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Numeric AppLovin account id (dashboard > account > Go to settings: the number after the account name); every Campaign Management call carries it as ?account_id=.

me.note: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /campaign/list?account_id=…&size=1, which verifies the Campaign Management key against the configured account.

list_campaigns.note: GET /campaign/list?account_id=…&page=…&size=… (a JSON array of Campaign objects, at most 100 per page). status is LIVE or PAUSED. `budget` is the global daily budget (a decimal string); campaigns with per-country budgets have it in raw.budget.country_code_to_daily_budget. `status` is not sent (no status filter is documented).

get_report.note: GET https://r.applovin.com/report?api_key=<Report Key>&start&end&columns=day,campaign,campaign_id_external,impressions,clicks,conversions,cost&format=json&report_type=advertiser (UTC; the request window is the last 45 days). Rows are read from `results`. `account_id` is not sent (the Report Key selects the account) and `campaign_id` is not applied: the report identifies campaigns by campaign_id_external (the campaign's hashed_id), not the numeric id list_campaigns returns.

update_budget.note: POST /campaign/update?account_id=… {id, type: APP, budget: {daily_budget_for_all_countries}} sets one uniform daily budget (account currency, USD) across all targeted countries; this spends money and replaces any per-country budgets. `currency` is ignored.

pause_resume.note: POST /campaign/update?account_id=… {id, type: APP, status: PAUSED|LIVE} (pause → PAUSED, resume → LIVE). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: The Campaign Management API works on one account given as the account_id query parameter and has no account-listing endpoint (https://support.applovin.com/en/growth/promoting-your-apps/api/axon-campaign-management-api: 'You also must add the account_id query parameter to each request').

evidence: host api.ads.axon.ai: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
